verses.text: Abraham moved south into the Negev and settled between Kadesh and Shur. For a time he lived in Gerar.
Abraham said Sarah his wife was his sister. So Abimelech, king of Gerar, sent for Sarah and took her.
But God came to Abimelech in a dream that night and said, "You're as good as dead because of the woman you took. She's married."
Abimelech had not gone near her. He said, "Lord, will you destroy an innocent nation too?
Didn't he tell me, 'She's my sister'? And didn't she herself say, 'He's my brother'? I did this with an honest heart and clean hands."
God said to him in the dream, "Yes, I know your heart was honest. I also kept you from sinning against me; that's why I didn't let you touch her.
Now return the man's wife. He's a prophet, and he'll pray for you so you can live. But if you don't return her, know for sure that you and everyone who belongs to you will die."
Abimelech got up early, called all his servants, and told them what had happened. They were terrified.
Then Abimelech called Abraham and said, "What have you done to us? What wrong did I do to you that you brought such guilt on me and my kingdom? You've done something that should never be done!"
Abimelech asked Abraham, "What were you thinking when you did this?"
Abraham replied, "I thought, 'People here don't fear God. They'll kill me to get my wife.'
Besides, she really is my sister: she's my father's daughter, but not my mother's daughter. And she became my wife.
When God sent me wandering from my father's household, I asked her, 'Show me this kindness wherever we go: say I'm your brother.'"
Abimelech gave Abraham sheep, cattle, male and female servants, and returned Sarah his wife to him.
Abimelech said, "My land is open to you. Settle wherever you like."
He said to Sarah, "I've given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. This clears your name in front of everyone with you; you're fully vindicated."
Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants so they could have children.
For Yahweh had made every woman in Abimelech's household unable to have children because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.
